atlasDraft.pZh: 天亮后，干纸仍在门槛边。阿汐没有拾起它。潮水退去，纸角留着一粒盐；潮水回来，纸仍是干的。薄簿合着，页角没有翻动。她听了一会儿，没听见纸响。门外的风停了，纸上多了一道浅痕，像有人把一句话放下，又没有带走。
atlasDraft.pEn: By daylight, the dry sheet remained beside the threshold. Axi did not pick it up. The tide withdrew, leaving a grain of salt on one corner; when it returned, the paper stayed dry. The ledger remained closed, its page corner still. She listened for a while and heard no paper sound. The wind stopped outside. A faint mark appeared on the sheet, as if someone had set down a sentence and left it there.
